title: phaseolus lathyroides var. hastifolius
intro: Phaseolus lathyroides var. hastifolius, commonly known as Indian laburnum or kidney bean, is a plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating respiratory issues, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus lathyroides var. hastifolius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been reported to possess analgesic, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research.
